questionText: Pointing to a photograph, a man said, 'I have no brother or sister but that man\'s father is my father\'s son.' Whose photograph was it?
explanation: 'My father\'s son' with no brothers means the speaker himself. Since the man\'s father is the speaker himself, the photograph is of his son.

questionText: Pointing to a lady, a man said, 'Her mother\'s only daughter is my mother.' How is the man related to the lady?
explanation: The lady\'s mother\'s only daughter is the lady herself. So the lady is the man\'s mother. Thus, the man is her son.

questionText: Introducing a girl, Vipin said, 'Her mother is the only daughter of my mother-in-law.' How is Vipin related to the girl?
explanation: Vipin\'s mother-in-law\'s only daughter is Vipin\'s wife. Since the girl\'s mother is Vipin\'s wife, Vipin is the girl\'s father.

questionText: A is B\'s sister. C is B\'s mother. D is C\'s father. E is D\'s mother. How is A related to D?
explanation: A is daughter of C, and C is daughter of D. Therefore, A is the granddaughter of D.

questionText: Pointing to a man, a woman said, 'His mother is the only daughter of my mother.' How is the woman related to the man?
explanation: 'Only daughter of my mother' is the woman herself. So the woman is his mother.

questionText: If P + Q means P is the brother of Q; P - Q means P is the sister of Q; and P * Q means P is the father of Q, which of the following means that C is the son of M?
explanation: M * N means M is father of N. N - C means N is sister of C. C + F means C is brother of F. So C is male and a child of M, hence C is the son of M.

questionText: A man said to a lady, 'Your mother\'s husband\'s sister is my aunt.' How is the lady related to the man?
explanation: Lady\'s mother\'s husband is lady\'s father. Lady\'s father\'s sister is lady\'s aunt. Since she is also the man\'s aunt, the lady is the man\'s sister (or cousin). In standard SSC options, Sister.

questionText: Pointing to a person, Deepak said, 'His only brother is the father of my daughter\'s father.' How is the person related to Deepak?
explanation: 'My daughter\'s father' is Deepak himself. Deepak\'s father is the only brother of the person. So the person is the brother of Deepak\'s father, i.e., Deepak\'s paternal uncle.

questionText: A is the brother of B. B is the daughter of C. D is the father of A. How is C related to D?
explanation: A and B are brother and sister. Their father is D. Since B is the daughter of C, C must be the mother, meaning C is the wife of D.

questionText: If A is the son of Q, Q and Y are sisters, Z is the mother of Y, P is the son of Z, then which of the following statements is true?
options: P is the maternal uncle of A
P is the brother of A
Z is the sister of A
explanation: Q and Y are sisters, Z is their mother. P is the son of Z, so P is brother of Q and Y. Since Q is the mother of A, P is the maternal uncle of A.

questionText: Introducing a man, a woman said, 'He is the only son of my mother\'s mother.' How is the woman related to the man?
explanation: Woman\'s mother\'s mother is maternal grandmother. Grandmother\'s only son is maternal uncle. Woman is the niece of the man.

questionText: A\'s mother is the sister of B and has a daughter C. How is A related to B\'s niece?
explanation: B\'s sister has daughter C, so C is B\'s niece. A is also the child of B\'s sister, so A is the brother of B\'s niece C.

questionText: Pointing to a photograph, a woman says, 'This man\'s son\'s sister is my mother-in-law.' How is the woman\'s husband related to the man in the photograph?
explanation: Man\'s son\'s sister is the man\'s daughter. She is the mother-in-law of the woman. Woman\'s husband is her son. So he is the daughter\'s son of the man in the photograph, which means Grandson.

questionText: B is the brother of A, whose only sister is mother of C. D is maternal grandmother of C. How is A related to D?
explanation: A\'s only sister is mother of C, so D (maternal grandmother of C) is the mother of A\'s sister and A. Since A has an 'only sister' and B is male, A must be female (daughter) or male (son). In SSC official key, A is the daughter.

questionText: Rahul\'s mother is the only daughter of Monika\'s father. How is Monika\'s husband related to Rahul?
explanation: Monika\'s father\'s only daughter is Monika herself. So Rahul\'s mother is Monika. Therefore, Monika\'s husband is Rahul\'s father.

questionText: P is the father of Q and R is the son of S. T is the brother of P. If Q is the sister of R, how is S related to T?
explanation: Q is sister of R, so Q and R are siblings. P is their father, R is son of S, so S is their mother (P\'s wife). T is brother of P, so S is T\'s sister-in-law.

questionText: Pointing to Ketan, Namrata said, 'He is the son of my father\'s only son.' How is Ketan\'s mother related to Namrata?
explanation: Namrata\'s father\'s only son is Namrata\'s brother. Ketan is his son. Ketan\'s mother is the wife of Namrata\'s brother, so she is Namrata\'s sister-in-law.

questionText: X is the husband of Y. W is the daughter of X. Z is the husband of W. N is the daughter of Z. How is Y related to N?
explanation: X and Y are husband and wife. W is their daughter. N is the daughter of W. Therefore, Y is the maternal grandmother (Nani) of N.

questionText: If 'A $ B' means A is the brother of B; 'A @ B' means A is the wife of B; 'A # B' means A is the daughter of B, what does 'P # Q @ R $ S' mean?
options: P is the daughter of R
P is the niece of S
P is the sister of S
P is the mother of S
explanation: Q @ R means Q is wife of R. P # Q means P is daughter of Q. So P is daughter of both Q and R. R $ S means R is brother of S. Hence P is the daughter of R.

questionText: Sunil is the son of Keshav. Simran, Keshav\'s sister, has a son Maruti and daughter Sita. Prem is the maternal uncle of Maruti. How is Sunil related to Maruti?
explanation: Sunil is the son of Keshav, while Maruti is the son of Simran (Keshav\'s sister). Children of siblings are cousins.

questionText: A man pointing to a lady says, 'Her grandfather is the only son of my grandfather.' How is the lady related to the man?
explanation: The speaker\'s grandfather\'s only son is the speaker\'s father. If the lady\'s grandfather is the speaker\'s father, the speaker is the lady\'s father (or uncle). Thus the lady is his daughter.

questionText: M is the sister of K. D is the brother of K. F is the mother of M. How is K related to F?
explanation: F is the mother of M, K, and D. Since the gender of K is not specified in the statement, K is either the son or daughter of F.

questionText: A is father of C and D is son of B. E is brother of A. If C is sister of D, how is B related to E?
explanation: C and D are siblings. A is father, so B must be mother (A\'s wife). E is brother of A, so B is E\'s sister-in-law.

questionText: Pointing towards a girl, Chetan said, 'She is the daughter of the only child of my grandmother.' How is Chetan related to that girl?
explanation: Chetan\'s grandmother\'s only child is Chetan\'s father/mother. The girl is the daughter of that child, so the girl is Chetan\'s sister, meaning Chetan is her brother.

questionText: Ravi\'s brother is Suresh. Suresh\'s sister is Meena. Ravi\'s father is Ram. How is Meena related to Ram?
explanation: Ravi, Suresh, and Meena are all siblings with Ram as their father. Therefore, Meena is Ram\'s daughter.

questionText: Amit introduces a boy saying, 'He is the son of the only brother of my father.' How is the boy related to Amit?
explanation: Amit\'s father\'s brother is paternal uncle. The uncle\'s son is a cousin.

questionText: If P is the mother of Amit, Amit is the sister of Q, and Q is the father of R, how is P related to R?
explanation: Q is the father of R, and P is the mother of Q. Therefore, P is the paternal grandmother of R.
